title: Offering Circular, Purchase Section — Purchase Room on a Class H Preferred Stock Holding, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The purchase room of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding is the most the member can buy at once.

## Terms

1. **Purchase room**: the lesser of the quarter room and the holding room, cut down to a whole multiple of the class's purchase increment; when the purchase room is below the class's minimum purchase, nothing can be bought.
2. **Quarter room**: the class's most preferred stock a member may buy in one calendar quarter less the holding's latest purchase when that is dated inside the current quarter, which runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.
3. **Holding room**: the class's largest balance a member may hold less the present shares, the present shares being purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements.

The class figures are those of the class schedules: for Class H Preferred Stock, purchases in multiples of USD 100, a minimum purchase of USD 1000, a largest balance of USD 1000000 and at most USD 250000 in one calendar quarter. The latest purchase is the purchase entry with the latest effective date on the holding.

## Worked figures (hypothetical holdings)

| Holding | Quarter room | Holding room | Lesser | Purchase room |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Present shares 820,000.00; latest purchase 40,000.00 dated 10 July 2026 | 250,000.00 less 40,000.00 gives 210,000.00 | 1,000,000.00 less 820,000.00 gives 180,000.00 | 180,000.00 | USD 180,000.00 |
| Present shares 943,456.78; latest purchase dated in 2025 | 250,000.00 | 56,543.22 | 56,543.22 | USD 56,500.00 — cut down to a whole USD 100 |
| Present shares 999,250.00 | 250,000.00 | 750.00 | 750.00 | Nothing — below USD 1000 |
| Present shares 400,000.00; latest purchase 245,000.00 dated 1 July 2026 | 5,000.00 | 600,000.00 | 5,000.00 | USD 5,000.00 |
